mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL crossing above 3.0 signals accelerating inflationary pressure, which induces market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal (binomial test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (demand) and PAYEMS (labor) proxies indicates expanding economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (e.g., correlation <0.3 or t-stat <1.5) fails to predict positive returns in >50% of instances (binomial test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates on equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, the 20d forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite the FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO index falling below 100 signals contraction in business inventory and production, which reduces corporate profit expectations and induces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5d returns in >50% of triggered instances despite negative signal (binomial test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (business investment) proxies indicates robust economic momentum, which accelerates corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (e.g., correlation <0.4 or t-stat <1.8) fails to predict positive returns in >70% of instances (binomial test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing above 4.3% indicates rising unemployment, which erodes consumer confidence and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal (binomial test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals policy accommodation to stabilize markets, which lowers discount rates on equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-shock recovery regime, the 60d forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite the FEDFUNDS decline.
